prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t pick one single “best” — the right painter depends on your budget, scope (single room vs whole house), timeline, and whether you want a smaller local shop or a larger franchise. I can, however, help you find a great contractor. Two ways I can help right now:

1) Quick guidance so you can choose confidently
- Get 3 written bids (same scope for each).
- Verify insurance and ask for proof of liability and workers’ comp.
- Check recent Google/Yelp/Angi reviews and ask for 2–3 recent local references and photos of finished work.
- Confirm prep work (patching, sanding, priming), number of coats, paint brands, and whether ceilings/trim are included.
- Ask about warranty/guarantee and cleanup policy.
- Don’t pay large up-front sums; typical deposits are 20–30% with final payment on completion and walkthrough.

Questions to ask every painter
- Are you licensed / insured? Can I see certificates?
- Do you provide a written estimate with line items (labor, materials, paint)?
- What paint brands and sheens do you use? Are low-VOC options available?
- How many coats will you apply? Is primer included if I change colors?
- What is the projected start date and completion time?
- Do you handle minor drywall repairs? Is that included in price?

2) If you want, I can find top-rated interior painters near you
Tell me your St. Louis zip code and a few project details (rooms, square footage, trim/ceilings, any repair work, target start date). I’ll pull together 3–5 highly rated local options, their specialties, typical price range, and what to ask each one.

If you prefer, I can also recommend well-known franchises that operate in St. Louis (they’re often reliable for standardized service) or focus on highly rated local shops. Which would you like?
